content.comment_body: Dear [user_name], I'm new to [product_name] and would like help in creating a simple ladder program for dual pumps operating in duty and standby mode, switching based on equal runtime. Could you assist me with such a program? ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from a discussion about 3 Pumps Control with 1 Standby and two active pumps used alternately.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. You can convert any FBD program to a LAD program by using the corresponding button in the Editor tab (see attachment). There are several pump-related programs in the forum. Please use the search function in the [product_name] section to find them. [url]
Thank you for your prompt response.

Consider programming in FBD. FBD offers several advantages over Ladder. The [company_name] website provides many web-based training resources for [product_name], which will help you learn. It’s not difficult. FBD gives you more control and options compared to Ladder.

analysis.insight_summary: A forum member, new to [product_name], asked for help developing a ladder program for controlling dual pumps in a duty standby setup based on equal runtime. Other participants recommended converting between programming types and explained the benefits of using Function Block Diagram over Ladder Diagram, pointing to [company_name]'s web-based training materials for further learning. No direct solution was offered, but the user’s beginner status was recognized.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear, beginner-friendly instructions or example code to implement duty standby control logic with equal runtime for dual pumps, preferably in ladder format.
